{{Quote|Hey, Scythe, welcome back to the land of the living.''"<br />"''Thank you, sir.|[[Pulsar (clone trooper)/Legends|Pulsar]] and Scythe, after the latter is infected by a brain worm|audio=WelcomeBack-BI.flac|<ref name="Brain Invaders">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>}}
'''Scythe''', designated '''CT-9544''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served under [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Trap/Legends|Trap]] in [[Tango Company/Legends|Tango Company]]. He had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of a tiger skull on his forehead.

==Biography==
[[File:Scythe_sleeping.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Scythe sleeping on Geonosis prior to being invaded by a brain worm]]
While on Geonosis, he was the first clone to be infected by a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]]. He then boarded the [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]], TB-73, and went into the barracks, releasing more [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Brain worm/Legends|Brain worms]] infecting the remaining clones. Scythe then took [[Ox/Legends|Ox]] and [[Edge/Legends|Edge]] to the bridge to kill the clone pilots. Then under the orders of Scythe, Ox and Edge went to the mess hall to get rid of their [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. Later he, along with Edge, pinned down an uninfected clone trooper while the infected Havoc used one of the [[Brain worm/Legends|Brain worms]] to infect the final clone on the ship. After Offee tried to reach the bridge but was stopped, Scythe took another [[Brain worm/Legends|Brain worm]] and infected her. Eventually, Scythe and the rest of the crew were freed from the infection when Ahsoka ruptured the cooling tanks.

==Equipment==
Scythe carried a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] carbine, and was featured wearing a back pack. He wore Phase I Armor that had blue markings, a large blue X shape on his chest and bore a striped sigil on his armored shoulder plates that resembled a stylized tiger face.
